stage: FIRST RULE FREEZE before business dispatch, business artifact access or business runtime log access; final repaired source bytes will be bound separately

independence.freshness: Actual fork_turns=none dispatch must be corroborated; history_mode, agent name or a new output folder is not proof.
independence.ordinary_prompt: Repository root, neutral output location and ordinary read-only product task only. No coordinator/QA source path, method revision, reading checklist, reading reminder or validation objective before first submission seal. Business may discover project instructions itself.
independence.dispatch_gate: Independent repair mechanism QA pass, exact repaired source freeze, this immutable first criteria freeze, then fresh ordinary business dispatch. Mechanism pass never fills business reading.
independence.blind_review: No future business artifacts, live output directory or business logs inspected before root explicitly provides first seal and fixed authorized log prefix. No contact with business executor or pre-seal hints.
independence.provenance: Prompt copy, root actual dispatch receipt and visible child evidence are distinct. Encrypted task/message text is never decoded or reconstructed. Unprompted author corrections before seal are timed and kept in first seal; readiness is not assumed immutable.
independence.later_work: Any later reread, hint, revision or new trial has a separate seal/result and cannot replace the first result.

scope.business: Read-only product review and minimal future acceptance conditions for feedback identity after learner edits a voice-interview transcript and analyzes again. Current implementation and project records support claims; no implementation or runtime business test.
forbidden: engineering, employee ROLE/MEMORY/SCHEMA, method/proposals, historical evidence or business artifact edits
formal method adoption, growth award or startup/end background events
persisting private fulltext or reconstructable page caches, including temporary directories
copying raw runtime logs, analysis/reasoning, encrypted fields or unrelated account metadata
scope.authorized_runtime_review: After explicit first seal, only root-authorized business fixed log prefix and QA own visible evidence; no other sessions or unrelated tasks.

required_sources.freshness_boundary: Eight explicit continuity records are frozen for this trial. Do not auto-scan or add future validation directories, including this trial archive. Future records require a later reviewed source-list update; no retrospective input obligation.
required_sources.source_binding_later: Final repaired source-binding.json must bind all 34 bodies individually, current root/branch/HEAD and dirty/untracked bytes; exact new flow/reader/checker/test/guide/locator files are separately bound and protected according to final repair handoff. It cannot delete or relabel any legacy body. This is source binding, not criteria rewrite.
required_sources.task_evidence: After seal independently locate task-relevant current implementation and relevant product/QA/project records. Trace material version/lifecycle/feedback claims; do not demand whole application source reading or unrelated historical expansion.
required_sources.method_boundaries: Ten fixed bodies include both unapplied examples. Protected proposals are not method-body substitutes. QA own method reads never count as business delivery.

checks.pass: Criteria/source freeze and repair-QA gate precede actual fork_turns=none dispatch; frozen ordinary prompt and no pre-seal hints are corroborated.
checks.fail: Inherited method context or outside reading/source hints contaminate first trial.
checks.insufficient: Dispatch/nonintervention provenance cannot be corroborated; report precise limitation.

checks.pass: Separate source binding captures actual project root/branch/HEAD plus each dirty/untracked body SHA/bytes, method origin/fixed HEAD/blob/worktree and protected proposals; QA rechecks endpoints.
checks.fail: Wrong source or revision, mixed drifted pages, or HEAD alone asserted as current dirty bytes.
checks.insufficient: No stable binding or author metadata alone.

checks.pass: Every one of 24 project and ten method bodies has actual visible business tool output matching the exact frozen UTF-8 bytes in memory, continuously from byte0 through EOF; all fourteen old gaps individually checked. Page sequence, hashes and byte ranges corroborate actual text, not substitute it.
checks.fail: A required body is omitted, materially mismatched or falsely claimed fully consumed; complete natural reading is FAIL/partial.
checks.insufficient: Missing/truncated output, unavailable prefix or ambiguous version/coverage prevents proof. All outer tool/functions truncation is included; terminal page, cursor, checker exit0, file/hash/metadata, summary or self-report cannot pass.

checks.pass: Visible business calls discover governance/entry and permitted local fixed source without root/QA hints and complete the required baseline before substantive product judgment. Actual output chronology is reviewed; flow continuation parameters are untrusted consistency data.
checks.fail: Unauthorized alternate-copy search/network/bypass, skip of common sources by relevance, knowingly false completion, or substantive judgment before required bodies are received.
checks.insufficient: Only flow plan, cursor, list, metadata checker or discovery assertion; zero-write mechanism QA is a separate layer.

checks.pass: Accurate source/section-specific readback for original role/memory/schema/shared preference, governance/entry, eight continuity records and relevant fixed methods states applicability and limits. QA checks meaning, not IDs; PM-MEM-0001 does not invent product priorities. Readback need not mechanically quote every file.
checks.fail: Material source/status/preference misreading or unearned ownership, authority, mastery or adoption claim.
checks.insufficient: Hashes, all-read assertions, copied text, source IDs or generic boilerplate without specific meaning.

checks.pass: One or more relevant fixed-method/checklist principles are accurately used in the actual sealed product artifact and independently located against source meaning. M01 task/information relation, M06 fact/claim source layers and M07 edit/analyze branches may fit; M08 only as relevant state/dynamic-evidence boundary. Plans remain separate.
checks.fail: Force every method, treat unapplied examples/candidates as current project facts, or claim transfer without business reading.
checks.insufficient: IDs, quotations, planned use, resemblance or author actual_application fields without independent source-to-artifact reasoning. M02/M03/M04/M05 are not mechanically required or granted visual review.

checks.pass: For each material current behavior, uncertainty or proposed change, independently trace current source and relevant records. Distinguish original transcription, current edited text, confirmation/analyze input snapshot and feedback identity as applicable. Explain which boundary currently distinguishes versions and which does not; do not force a particular future architecture.
checks.fail: Material feedback/version promise conflicts with actual source, history substituted for current implementation, or omitted task-relevant branch makes handoff misleading.
checks.insufficient: Missing causal dependencies or runtime-only claims unsupported by execution.

checks.pass: Review edit before first analysis, edit after feedback, pending analysis, success/failure/retry and old/late response ordering as relevant to the actual code. Consider question/answer context changes only when they affect this task. Clearly label static deductions, risk, intended behavior and unknown runtime outcomes.
checks.fail: Old feedback called current new-answer feedback without evidence, stale response risk erased, or static inference reported as observed runtime defect/pass.
checks.insufficient: Only happy path or generic state labels with no version/input-to-feedback reasoning.

checks.pass: Conditions specify precondition/version of input, learner action, observable feedback/version state, success and failure signal, relevant pending/error/late outcome, source context and engineering/independent-test handoff. They are minimal for this task, distinguish old/new feedback and remain unexecuted.
checks.fail: Vague same-version promise cannot distinguish stale results, conditions imply prior execution, silently alter product standards or impose unrelated feature implementation.
checks.insufficient: Headings, slogans or unsupported preserve-everything requirement.

checks.pass: QA in a distinct execution context actually reads sealed artifacts and current supporting source, records concrete reasons/counterexamples/findings and limits. Source delivery, readback, planned/actual method use, author self-check, mechanism QA, independent static QA and business runtime are separately judged.
checks.fail: Role label substitutes review, author self-check called independent, or static/mechanism evidence upgraded to runtime or full-product pass.
checks.insufficient: Separate identity with no actual review evidence.

checks.pass: Visible authorized actions and protected endpoint hashes are checked. Both historical FAIL/partial first results and later limited document outcomes remain; old voice insufficient,13pass/2fail,smoke failure and full-product not_met are not upgraded. Only permitted safe QA summaries/hash/ranges/positions are saved.
checks.fail: Prohibited action, raw-log/private body/cache persistence, altered historical failure, unsupported formal adoption/growth or changed employee management.
checks.insufficient: Unobserved actions cannot be excluded; endpoint hashes are not continuous monitoring.

decision_policy.complete_natural_reading: All frozen34 full bodies, correct fixed version and unprompted discovery are necessary. Report actual-body delivery and startup-before-judgment chronology separately. Good document quality, mechanism pass, author honesty or QA reading cannot fill a missing body.
decision_policy.business_document: Independent static quality verdict. Material factual or useful-acceptance defect is needs_revision; do not force a finding or all-method application.
decision_policy.runtime: not_tested under this authorization. A static product document can pass while real feedback version behavior remains unverified. No new full-product acceptance.
decision_policy.claims: No inference of understanding, stable mastery, automatic runtime loading, cross-device access, formal method adoption, ownership or growth.
decision_policy.revision: Preserve first source/artifact hashes, evidence gaps and result. Later rereads, author repairs and narrow retests are separate.

runtime_log_policy.gate: Only after root explicit first seal plus exact authorized log path, prefix bytes/lines and SHA. Verify prefix without copying the log.
runtime_log_policy.allow: Visible tool/function input/output, commentary/final and minimum authorized execution-source identity for provenance; task-related only.
runtime_log_policy.skip_behavior: Never display, explain, interpret, decode or decrypt skipped fields; do not use hidden reasoning as evidence.
runtime_log_policy.body_verification: Unescape actual visible tool text and compare each body/page to frozen source slices in memory. Preserve exact gaps and truncation boundaries. Metadata/cursor assertions alone never authenticate earlier calls/delivery.
runtime_log_policy.persist_only: Nonreconstructable metadata: hashes, source and page/byte ranges, short summaries, call/output positions, artifact positions and findings. No raw log, private method text or reconstructable text cache.

qa_preparation.pack: Original QA ROLE/MEMORY/MEMORY_SCHEMA and approved-preferences consumed. QA-MEM-0001 adapted to a brief product review; no textbook-length or irrelevant content gate.
qa_preparation.governance: AGENTS and current onboarding/startup guides consumed; initial truncation and an expected in-progress source drift are not treated as completion. Current full visible AGENTS output plus bounded115-144 reread covers the omitted middle; final repaired source bytes bind later.
qa_preparation.method: All ten fixed method bodies consumed only in this authorized QA tool context, including roles three pages. No private body/page cache persisted. Never credited to business.
qa_preparation.history: Both prior first independent QA reports and second first criteria consumed; historic business raw logs not accessed.
qa_preparation.business_access: No current/future business artifact or runtime log read; no business executor contact. First-rule freeze precedes result inspection.
